original_test_intent: Demonstrate that two InfiniBand topology snapshots and ibtopodiff identify the exact intentionally removed cable/link, including the optional CX7 port-focused query, and that the fabric recovers after reconnection.
original_method: Approve a lab fabric and exact GUID/serial/port/cable endpoints; baseline routes/jobs/link health; generate a verified first ibnd snapshot; drain/isolate the chosen redundant path; qualified operator removes only the labeled cable and timestamps/photos it; capture second snapshot; run both applicable diff commands; match missing endpoints to the physical label; reconnect and verify link/topology/routes return without collateral changes.
manual_activity: Qualified operator verifies labels, removes/reconnects one approved cable and records physical evidence; fabric owner approves isolation and recovery.
required_inputs: Cable endpoint labels and GUID/port/peer map
Whether literal GUID and CX7 selector apply
Link recovery deadline and poststate oracle
safety_requirements: Never unplug an unverified or sole management/fabric path
Reconnect once and verify recovery; no automated physical retry

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic topodiff description is incomplete and its topology-deploy warning is not the source action.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal commands only after proving selectors match the approved lab target; hash both ibnd files and preserve full stdout/stderr.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: topology1/topology2, GUID, -V and optional serial/port summary retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use operator/agent hold points and a topology-diff-to-cable-label trace matrix, followed by a third recovery snapshot or equivalent health proof.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe path selection, workload drain, immutable snapshot identity and explicit recovery validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A synthetic file diff cannot replace the required physical removal/localization demonstration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Removing the wrong or nonredundant link may partition the fabric; stale hard-coded GUIDs can make a valid diff target the wrong device.

project_override_considerations: Owner confirms whether the literal GUID/serial/port are project-specific, what topology differences besides the target link are tolerated and what constitutes restored routing/service.
expected_evidence: Pre-removal health and first snapshot hash

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek's copied subnet-merger/topology-deploy risk misstates the action; Master and GPT V2 consistently require a controlled physical cable removal between topology snapshots.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete; execution gated by physical target identity, isolation, qualified operator and recovery plan.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row427 Wistron-L12 Cluster-00009-V002: approve lab fabric, exact cable endpoints/labels/GUID/ports/peer and applicability of 0xa088c203002f72ec plus H-946dae0300cf013a:1, redundancy/job drain/OOB, tolerated diff, reconnect deadline and full recovery oracle.

review_improvement: Binds the topology delta to one approved physical action and requires proof that localization and recovery both work.
independent_technical_reasoning: A topology diff can correctly show a missing logical edge yet still fail the physical localization goal if GUID/port labels are stale. The operator record and endpoint map must therefore be compared with both snapshots, and recovery must prove no unintended path remained absent.
